subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently overwriting [AI-assisted]model-selection: warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently …

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the shipped last-match selection while warning, or may this PR intentionally switch existing duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning itself is straightforward, but selecting a different provider/model from existing config is a compatibility and auth-provider routing decision that should not be inferred from an external drive-by PR.

options.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
options.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and add matching alias-index coverage.

options.title: Approve first-match precedence
options.body: Accept the behavior break only with explicit upgrade proof, tests, and release-note context for possible provider/model rerouting.

options.title: Pause for a unified replacement
options.body: Use one coherent fix or canonical PR to cover both resolver paths if maintainers do not want to repair this branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
recommendation.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit a duplicate warning, and add matching alias-index coverage.
